overview.label: Overview
overview.description: What the agent can draw in its answers, and the switch that allows it.

families.label: Families
families.description: Choose which kinds of drawing the agent may use, and see what each costs.

try.label: Try it
try.description: Requests that bring out each kind of drawing.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.description: Collections of examples to look through: pick one, then a card to see it large with its source.

switch.title: Rich answers
switch.on: On: the agent may answer with tables, graphs, forms and sketches.
switch.off: Off: the agent answers with text only.

pieces.title: Fixed pieces only
pieces.hint: The agent picks from a catalogue of pieces. It never writes code or a page.

click.title: Nothing without your click
click.hint: A form or a quiz sends a message only when you press its button, and you see it first.

local.title: Everything stays here
local.hint: What you type in a block stays on this computer until you send it.

families.hint: Automatic: a family is taught to the agent only when the request calls for it. Always: it is taught to every request, which costs more. Never: it is not used.

charts.hint: Plots of formulas, sliders, histograms, heatmaps.

forms.hint: Exercises, quizzes, flashcards, drafts to edit.

design.hint: Sketches of a site or an app, colour palettes.

architecture.hint: Drawings of systems, with the logos of technologies.

tryIt.hint: Each request opens a new chat with the text ready to send.

quiz.label: A quiz
quiz.prompt: Make me a quiz of 5 questions on Go goroutines, with explanations, and a button to send you my score.

cards.label: Flashcards
cards.prompt: Create flashcards of English travel vocabulary, with a category and a pronunciation on each.

essay.label: A writing exercise
essay.prompt: Train me to write in English: give me a subject of 100 to 150 words and a box to write my answer in.

sine.label: A graph to explore
sine.prompt: Make an interactive graph of sine, cosine and tangent with sliders for amplitude, frequency, phase and vertical shift, and show the current equation.

parabola.label: A parabola
parabola.prompt: Show me the parabola f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k with sliders for a, h and k, and mark its vertex on the graph.

site.label: A site sketch
site.prompt: Show me what the site of an artisan bakery could look like, with a colour palette.

dashboard.label: Dashboard
dashboard.prompt: Sketch a dashboard for a project management tool: side bar, key figures, a trend curve and a table of projects.

architecture.label: An architecture
architecture.prompt: Draw the architecture of a RAG chatbot on AWS: documents in S3, a Lambda that indexes them, a vector database and an API.

gallery.nothingSent: Nothing yet: press a button, a choice, a quiz result or a form.

landing.title: Landing pages
landing.description: Sketches of the home page of a site, by trade: a colour, a font and a mood for each.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.description: Screens of an app in a phone: figures, curves, lists and one clear button.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Side bar, key figures, curves and tables: the look of a product for every kind of work.

brand.title: Brand boards
brand.description: Palettes, buttons, pictures and moods: the same page in other colours, fonts and corners.

math.title: Maths lab
math.description: Functions to explore: move a slider, and the curve, the marks and the equation follow.

calculators.title: Calculators
calculators.description: Small tools that answer as you move a slider: money, motion, units and health.

data.title: Data science
data.description: The pictures of a model: learning curves, errors, correlations and classification.

cloud.title: Cloud architectures
cloud.description: Systems drawn with the logos of the services they use: AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka and others.

learning.title: Learn and practise
learning.description: Quizzes, cards, writing exercises and revision plans, to answer in the conversation.

work.title: Decisions and reports
work.description: The documents of a working week: status, roadmap, comparisons, decisions, checklists and mail.

core.title: The agent's examples
core.description: The short examples the agent is taught from: tables, steps, charts, forms and a first sketch of a page.
